entities.name: Élan d'Avenant
entities.description: An archer squire of the Order of the D'Avenant on Dominaria, sent to kill Jared Carthalion.

entities.name: Order of the D'Avenant
entities.description: Order on Dominaria to which Élan belonged.

entities.name: Hamath
entities.description: Town with which an alliance was to be sealed.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Man believed to be a minion of Ravidel; target of Élan.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Battlemage who dueled Jared and incinerated Élan.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Took Jared away before Élan could kill him.

entities.name: Exarch Amadis
entities.description: Exarch whose magic shook the tree during the battle against the Calthyn Elves.

entities.name: Calthyn Elves
entities.description: Elves fought in the battle in the White Woods.

entities.name: White Woods
entities.description: Woods where Élan followed Jared and Kristina.

events.summary: Élan is to kill Jared Carthalion to seal an alliance with Hamath, but Kristina takes him away first.
events.quote: However, before she could kill him, Kristina of the Woods took him away.

events.summary: Élan follows them to the White Woods but falls from her hiding tree when Exarch Amadis' magic shakes it.
events.quote: Élan followed Jared and Kristina to the White Woods

events.summary: Jared accidentally summons Élan during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerates her.
events.quote: Jared accidentally summoned her during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerated her.

relations.quote: Jared accidentally summoned her during a duel with Ravidel, and the Battlemage incinerated her.
Élan d'Avenant was an archer squire of the Order of the D'Avenant on Dominaria .
